integrity: Proof is analytic; 432 exact/numerical supplementary checks do not certify an infinite theorem. First-public date is for the motivating preprint, not this result.
scientific_limitations: Sharp finite-jet compression only; no full rank-one Toeplitz realization, exact leading asymptotic constant, or independent publication-priority certification. General weighted L1 endpoint extremal theory is a residual possible route to equivalent results.
title: Sharp Fock vacuum-jet symbol costs: alternating shells and dimension-degree growth
